newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel T&T expects better second half.
newsitem.headline: Keppel T&T expects better second half.

text.p: Keppel Telecommunications & Transportation Ltd said on Tuesday it expected the second half operating performance to show an improvement over the first half.
But the results for the full year are expected to be lower than last year, it said.
The group reported a 18.6 percent drop in interim profit to Singapore $4.71 million.
It said in a statement accompanying its first half results, the telecommunications division's businesses continue to grow and are expected to do well.

"The cellular phone and paging services launched in April 1997 by associate MobileOne (Asia) Pte Ltd have been well received and the investment plans for the associate have been brought forward," it said.
For its shipping division, regional feeder trades and charter markets have softened.
It is expected to take delivery of three more container feeder vessels in the second half.
Earnings from shipping however, will ease in the short-term due to depressed market conditions, it said.
The group said its logistics division would add another 10,000 square metres of warehouse space in the second half. Further capacity will be added when it develops a 12 acre site in Singapore.
